description: Status of a workspace at a glance: who is signed in, the current workspace (and the user's others), the folder tree with the apps and databases in each folder (or at the root), each app's deployment status, live URL, custom domain, framework, repository, branch and environments, each database's state, and which GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket accounts are connected. Call it whenever the user asks for status or about their sites, wants to organise the dashboard, or before deploying, instead of guessing.
name: get-workspace-overview
